image_description: A close-up shot of a chocolate ice cream scoop resting on a white wafer or cookie, held by a human hand. The ice cream is glossy, dark brown, and appears to be melting slightly, with some sauce or melted ice cream dripping onto the wafer and fingers. There is a dollop of white whipped cream on top of the chocolate scoop. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The surface of the chocolate ice cream is exceptionally smooth and plastic-like, lacking the subtle micro-texture or tiny ice crystals often seen in real macro photography of ice cream. It resembles rendered CGI more than photographic detail.

The way the melted chocolate interacts with the wafer and fingers looks slightly unnatural. The drips lack clear surface tension definition and appear to 'smear' into the skin and wafer rather than sitting on top or flowing distinctly.

The background blur is very aggressive and uniform, typical of AI-generated depth-of-field effects. The edges of the fingers holding the wafer show slight softness and blending into the background, which could indicate edge bleeding.
